git_promotion_readiness.details: Integration HEAD is a strict descendant of Dev baseline and Agent v0 source baseline. No fast-forward blockers exist.

python_baseline_failure_attribution.details: All 12 failing/erring tests are 100% identical to the pre-existing Dev baseline (AOSP toolchain missing, Graphiti client attribute, and worker error assertion). Zero new regressions.

sqlite_v16_migration_gate.details: Full migration matrix passed across fresh v16, v7, v8, v9-v15, and RCA-2A.4 frozen database. Immutability triggers and constraints validated.

cpp_engine_regression.details: All critical C++ engine contracts (task lifecycle, database access, C++/Python IPC) fully preserved.

chromium_workbench_e2e.details: Investigation Workbench Column 3 execution and review loop fully verified end-to-end under real Chromium browser.

evidence_and_audit_artifact_isolation.details: Forensic database SHA-256 digests 100% match audit baseline. Zero leaks of E01, credentials, or task databases in git diff.

remaining_limitations.description: 8 legacy Android container unit tests fail due to missing local .deps/aosp-android10-r36 directory. Pre-existing on Dev baseline; does not affect Agent v0.
remaining_limitations.resolution_plan: Populate AOSP prebuilt binaries in CI/environment before Android container release.

remaining_limitations.description: 3 Graphiti cleanup unit tests fail with AttributeError ('_worker_clients') due to Dev baseline Ingestor interface evolution.
remaining_limitations.resolution_plan: Update unit tests in Dev to match current GraphitiIngestor public interface.

remaining_limitations.description: 1 worker episode unit test fails on assertion message mismatch. Pre-existing on Dev baseline.
remaining_limitations.resolution_plan: Align worker unit test assertion with exception return value in Dev.

remaining_limitations.description: In local mode, reviewer identity is declared by the local caller without cryptographic token validation. Disclosed in UI notice.
remaining_limitations.resolution_plan: Enterprise multi-user RBAC and cryptographic session validation deferred to future enterprise roadmap.

remaining_limitations.description: The raw E01 image file (~7.55 GB) has no pre-test historical SHA-256 hash recorded in git repository benchmarks; integrity is enforced via OS-level read-only mount, byte size verification (7,556,437,602 bytes), and strict read-only access flags.
remaining_limitations.resolution_plan: Generate and anchor immutable SHA-256 manifest for large binary evidence test fixtures in future dataset packaging.
